projectState.summary: Byte 13b-c4 is approved and merged to `main` with Byte 13b-c3 included. Musical persistence ids include a play-span serial (`musical-<sessionId>-span-<playSpanSerial>-<sourceEventId>`) because transport-local source event ids reset to `event-0` on every start while the browser session stays stable. The source buffer captures the play-span serial at enqueue time, payload schema v1 stays unchanged, and smoke plays/stops twice and asserts persisted musical rows equal total drained source events with each span ordered independently. Next planned work is Byte 14: producer marker plus deterministic rule-based text input, no LLM.
